summary: Comprehensive frontend UI flow testing for FinLingo Phase 1 against the public preview URL. Tested 15 critical flows end-to-end: landing→signup CTA, login (demo creds prefilled), header chips, dashboard hero+daily progress+3 course cards, enrollment (LOMA-280), course path concept-node interactions, full lesson player (intro→mcq→scenario→finish), result screen pills, return to path, leaderboard nav with 'You' marker, achievements unlock state for first_step, protected-route guard, signup with random user. 14/15 flows PASSED. The only failure is a logout UX race causing redirect to /login instead of landing /.

ui_bugs.issue: Logout race condition: AppShell calls `logout(); nav('/');` without awaiting the async logout. nav('/') fires before user state is cleared, so PublicOnly on Landing sees a truthy user and redirects to /dashboard, then Protected sees the now-cleared user and bounces to /login. Net effect: clicking logout lands the user on /login instead of the landing page '/'. Spec said: 'Logout via btn-logout — redirects to landing /'.
ui_bugs.fix_suggestion: In /app/frontend/src/components/AppShell.jsx change `onClick={() => { logout(); nav('/'); }}` to `onClick={async () => { await logout(); nav('/'); }}` OR move nav('/') inside the logout() function in AuthContext after setUser(false).

action_items: Fix logout race: await logout() before nav('/') in AppShell, so user lands on Landing page instead of /login.

(Informational, not a bug) Demo user already had concepts mastered from prior runs, so repeat completion correctly awarded 0 XP per the idempotency contract — header XP did not increase during retest. New signed-up users would see XP increase. Backend idempotency working as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: AppShell logout handler does not await an async function — classic state/navigation race; same pattern should be audited elsewhere if present.

LessonPlayer goes back via `nav(-1)` from result screen — this depends on history; if user navigated directly to /concept/<id>, back may not return to /learn/<id>. Consider explicit nav(`/learn/${courseId}`).
AuthPage prefills `demo@finlingo.com / Demo@123` in production form state — fine for Phase 1 demo, but should be gated behind an env flag before launch.
401 console errors appear during auth init / unauthenticated /api/auth/me calls — expected behavior, but consider suppressing the noise in axios interceptor for the /auth/me bootstrap call.
seed_data_creation: Created one signup user qauser_<random>@finlingo.com / Test@123 during signup flow validation; no cleanup performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 15 flows from the review request were exercised. The 14 passing flows are stable. Only the logout-to-landing redirect is broken (lands on /login). After main agent applies the await fix in AppShell, re-run only the logout flow to confirm landing-signup is visible at '/'. MCQ flow used brute-force option 0 selections (mastery may be partial, but progression and result screen worked). Demo user already mastered concepts, so XP idempotency masked the 'XP increases' assertion — use a fresh signup user if validating XP increments specifically.

rca of the issue.root_cause: AppShell.jsx line 52: `onClick={() => { logout(); nav('/'); }}` invokes async `logout()` but does not await it. The navigation to '/' executes before AuthContext.setUser(false) runs. PublicOnly guard at '/' still sees the stale user object and redirects to /dashboard; by the time /dashboard renders, logout() has completed, so Protected sees !user and redirects to /login.
rca of the issue.reproduction: 1) Login as demo@finlingo.com  2) Click btn-logout  3) Observe URL becomes /login instead of /
rca of the issue.mitigation: Change to `onClick={async () => { await logout(); nav('/'); }}` in /app/frontend/src/components/AppShell.jsx, or perform the navigation inside the logout() function in AuthContext.jsx after setUser(false).
